rows.grounds: compound naming one who causes hatred toward corrupters

items.question: Which destructive powers does this goddess exercise against corrupters?
premises: The goddess causes hatred toward corrupters.
items.inference: Therefore she is a destructive goddess who consumes corrupters through hatred and fire.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of the three adjectives is not specified by the token list alone.
items.plain_english: She causes hatred toward corrupters, she burns, and her nature is burning.
